title: unified-rollouts: improve probing/observability and auto-rollback heuristics for canary + shadow
author: Priya Shankar
description:
Motivation: improve rollout safety and signal quality for canary + shadow flows by enhancing probing behavior, adding targeted telemetry, and tightening auto-rollback heuristics. In recent incidents we observed noisy metrics during short-lived spikes that caused either false positives for rollback or delayed detection. This PR consolidates probing stages, adds quorum-based metric aggregation for probes, and instruments per-route rollback signals in the observability stack.

What changed (high level): 1) Probing orchestration: introduce a 'probing stage' that runs short, controlled synthetic traffic probes against both canary and shadow variants before promoting traffic. Probes use weighted queries and a quorum of metrics (latency P99, error rate, model score regression) rather than single-metric triggers. 2) Auto-rollback engine: change from single-threshold triggers to composite-score thresholds with configurable weights and minimum sample windows; add a short quarantine window before hard rollback to avoid noisy flip-flops. 3) Observability: export new metrics and traces (rollout.probe.* namespace) and add per-route rollback events to the event stream for easier correlation in Console. 4) Safety & tests: add e2e stability test for staged probing and a fuzz test that simulates transient infra noise.

Checklist: - [x] Probing orchestration and state machine implementation - [x] Composite metric evaluator and config schema - [x] Observability metrics and tracing hooks - [x] e2e tests and unit tests for rollback heuristics - [x] Docs and release notes - [x] Manual canary run and validation in staging

Backwards compatibility: config schema adds optional fields with sensible defaults; old configs behave the same unless new fields are set. Breaking change: none.

Notes on deployment: rollout is gated behind feature flag rollout.probing_v2; recommend enabling for a small set of customers first (dedicated pools) and validating Console dashboards for the new metrics.

Related: ENG-3421 (probing improvements), ENG-3589 (rollback observability improvements).

review_comments: Marco Alvarez (reviewer): Left a couple of comments on the composite evaluator. Need to ensure weight defaults are documented and safe. Also: suggest adding a min-sample-size guard to avoid noisy decisions.
Priya Shankar (author): Addressed in commit d4e5f6a; added minSampleSize config and documented defaults in rollout_config_schema.yaml.
Lena Park (reviewer): Observability changes look good. Please add the Console dashboard row for per-route rollback events so SRE can run queries more easily.
Priya Shankar (author): Added dashboard in console/dashboards/rollouts_overview.json and an example query in rollout_probe_metrics.md.

Omar Hassan (reviewer): e2e was flaky initially in CI due to timing assumptions. Recommend increasing probe sample window in test and add a retry harness.
Author: updated tests to use deterministic probe inputs and added retry backoff. CI reran and passed.
release_notes: Improved rollout safety: added staged probing and composite auto-rollback heuristics; new rollout.probe.* metrics and Console dashboard rows; e2e tests for probing stability. No breaking changes.
